requirement_text: Chemists shall be able to view open prescriptions assigned to them based on pincode and update the status, with medicines delivered offline to patients.
user_story: As a chemist, I want to view open prescriptions assigned to me by pincode and update their status, so that I can track deliveries made offline to patients.
technical_task: Show each chemist the open prescriptions assigned to them based on pincode and let them change a prescription's status.
acceptance_criteria: Given open prescriptions assigned by pincode, when a chemist opens their list, then only the prescriptions assigned to that chemist are shown.
Given an open prescription, when the chemist updates its status, then the new status is saved.
rationale: Role stated: chemist. The medicines are delivered offline, so the system only records the status.

requirement_text: The system shall provide screens to view tracked metrics, set goals, and configure monitoring settings.
user_story: As a user, I want screens to view tracked metrics, set goals and configure monitoring settings, so that I can follow my progress.
technical_task: Build three screens: one for tracked metrics, one for setting goals and one for configuring monitoring settings.
acceptance_criteria: Given tracked metrics, when the user opens the metrics screen, then the metrics are displayed.
Given the goals screen, when the user sets a goal, then the goal is saved.
Given the settings screen, when the user changes a monitoring setting, then the setting is saved.

requirement_text: The input data a timestamp and the fact that the status was reported by "case manager" and their MID are saved.
requirement_text_raw: The input data  a timestamp  and the fact that the status was reported by "case manager" and their MID are saved.
user_story: As a case manager, I want the input data, a timestamp, the fact that I reported the status and my MID saved, so that the report can be traced to me.
technical_task: Save the input data with a timestamp, a marker that the status was reported by a case manager, and the case manager's MID.
acceptance_criteria: Given a case manager reports a status, when the report is saved, then the input data and a timestamp are saved.
Given the saved report, when it is viewed, then it shows that it was reported by "case manager" and shows the MID.

requirement_text: The system shall enable the administrator to (1) add a new entry for an appointment type including its type name with up to 30 alpha characters and duration in the unit of minutes and (2) modify the duration in an existing entry .
requirement_text_raw: The system shall enable the administrator to (1) add a new entry for an appointment type  including its type name with up to 30 alpha characters and duration in the unit of minutes   and (2) modify the duration in an existing entry .
user_story: As an administrator, I want to add appointment types with a type name of up to 30 alpha characters and a duration in minutes, and to change the duration of an existing entry, so that appointments are scheduled correctly.
technical_task: Provide add and modify functions for appointment types: a name of up to 30 alpha characters, a duration in minutes, and a way to edit the duration of an existing entry.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new appointment type, when the administrator enters a name of up to 30 alpha characters and a duration in minutes, then the entry is added.
Given an existing appointment type, when the administrator changes its duration, then the entry shows the new duration.

requirement_text: The system shall provide uninterrupted functionality both with and without an internet connection. In offline mode, users should still be able to access certain features. In online mode, the system should operate smoothly.
clarification_questions: Which features must be available in offline mode?
What does "operate smoothly" mean in online mode?

requirement_text: The BMS may supervise the charge taken out of the battery while the contactors are closed due to this request.
user_story: As a battery system engineer, I want the BMS to be able to supervise the charge taken out of the battery while the contactors are closed because of this request, so that charge usage is monitored.
technical_task: Allow the BMS to supervise the charge drawn from the battery during the time the contactors are closed due to the request.
acceptance_criteria: Given the contactors are closed because of this request, when charge is taken out of the battery, then the BMS can supervise it.
Given the contactors are open, when no request is active, then the supervision of this charge is not required.
rationale: Role assumed: battery system engineer. "May" makes the supervision optional for the BMS.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to add type information to their data.
user_story: As a user, I want to add type information to my data, so that I can classify it.
technical_task: Offer a type field on user data that the user can fill in.
acceptance_criteria: Given a data item, when the user adds type information, then the type is saved with the item.
Given a data item with type information, when the user views it, then the type is shown.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The set of types is not described.

requirement_text: The TCS shall have the capability to control and monitor multiple types of AVs.
user_story: As a controller operator, I want the TCS to control and monitor multiple types of AVs, so that I can manage a mixed fleet.
technical_task: Make the TCS able to command and monitor more than one type of AV.
acceptance_criteria: Given AVs of different types, when the operator sends a command, then the TCS controls each type of AV.
Given AVs of different types, when the operator views them, then the TCS monitors each type of AV.
rationale: Role assumed: controller operator. The AV types are not listed.

requirement_text: Upon completion of logging a Power-up test or Initial BIT test failure, the FTSS system shall consider the ICP failed and attempt recovery actions as stated in requirement 3.3.5.29.
requirement_text_raw: Upon completion of logging a Power-up test or Initial BIT test failure, the FTSS system shall (3.3.2.44) consider the ICP failed and attempt recovery actions as stated in requirement 3.3.5.29.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the FTSS system to treat the ICP as failed and attempt recovery after logging a Power-up test or Initial BIT test failure, so that failures are handled consistently.
technical_task: When logging of a Power-up test or Initial BIT test failure completes, mark the ICP as failed and start the recovery actions defined in requirement 3.3.5.29.
acceptance_criteria: Given a Power-up test or Initial BIT test failure has been logged, when logging completes, then the FTSS system considers the ICP failed.
Given the ICP is considered failed, when logging completes, then recovery actions as stated in requirement 3.3.5.29 are attempted.

requirement_text: User shall be able to request transportation routes.
user_story: As a commuter, I want to request transportation routes, so that I can plan my trip.
technical_task: Add a route request function for transportation routes.
acceptance_criteria: Given a start and destination, when the user requests a route, then transportation routes are returned.
Given a returned route, when the user views it, then its details are shown.

requirement_text: News will be restricted to what is available in the feeds on the list of news RSS-feeds.
user_story: As a reader, I want news limited to the feeds on the list of news RSS feeds, so that I see only approved sources.
technical_task: Restrict news content to items from the feeds on the configured list of news RSS feeds.
acceptance_criteria: Given the list of news RSS feeds, when news is displayed, then it comes only from those feeds.
Given a feed that is not on the list, when news is displayed, then nothing from that feed is shown.

requirement_text: When in billing mode, a surface computer shall display a representation of tip denominations that may be dragged into a payment.
requirement_text_raw: When in billing mode, a surface computer shall display a representation of tip  denominations that may be dragged into a payment.
user_story: As a waiter, I want a surface computer in billing mode to show tip denominations that I can drag into a payment, so that I can add a tip quickly.
technical_task: Show a representation of tip denominations on the surface computer in billing mode and make them draggable into a payment.
acceptance_criteria: Given the surface computer in billing mode, when the bill is displayed, then tip denominations are represented.
Given a tip denomination, when the user drags it into a payment, then it is added to the payment.

requirement_text: User shall expect the database to update data in less than 1 second to ensure timely information retrieval.
user_story: As a user, I want the database to update data in less than 1 second, so that the information I retrieve is current.
technical_task: Make database updates complete in less than 1 second.
acceptance_criteria: Given a data update, when it is performed, then it completes in less than 1 second.
Given an update has completed, when the user retrieves the data, then the updated data is returned.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The workload for the measurement is not stated.

requirement_text: Search agents shall automatically send resumes matching specified criteria via email daily.
user_story: As a recruiter, I want search agents to email me resumes that match my criteria every day, so that I see new candidates without searching.
technical_task: Run search agents that match resumes against specified criteria and email the matches daily.
acceptance_criteria: Given specified criteria, when the daily run happens, then matching resumes are sent by email.
Given no resume matches, when the daily run happens, then no resumes are sent.

requirement_text: CMS official named in section 20 (or to his or her successor).
rationale: The text is a fragment that names an official and a section and states no behaviour.
clarification_questions: What must the system do regarding the CMS official?

requirement_text: User shall determine brokerage by multiplying transaction amount by brokerage percentage.
user_story: As a broker, I want brokerage determined by multiplying the transaction amount by the brokerage percentage, so that charges are calculated consistently.
technical_task: Calculate brokerage as transaction amount times brokerage percentage.
acceptance_criteria: Given a transaction amount and a brokerage percentage, when brokerage is determined, then it equals the amount multiplied by the percentage.
Given a zero transaction amount, when brokerage is determined, then the result is zero.

requirement_text: System shall support dataset deposition and management through integration with Virtual Research Environments and other familiar workflow tools.
user_story: As a researcher, I want to deposit and manage datasets through Virtual Research Environments and other familiar workflow tools, so that I work in the tools I already use.
technical_task: Integrate dataset deposition and management with Virtual Research Environments and other familiar workflow tools.
acceptance_criteria: Given a Virtual Research Environment, when a researcher deposits a dataset from it, then the dataset is deposited in the system.
Given a deposited dataset, when the researcher manages it from a supported workflow tool, then the changes are applied.
rationale: Role assumed: researcher. The "other familiar tools" are not listed.

requirement_text: User shall have the option to enable two-factor authentication for added security.
user_story: As a user, I want the option to enable two-factor authentication, so that my account is more secure.
technical_task: Offer two-factor authentication as an option users can switch on.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user's account settings, when the user enables two-factor authentication, then it is turned on.
Given two-factor authentication is on, when the user signs in, then a second factor is required.

requirement_text: The user interface shall be responsive, adapting to various devices and browsers.
user_story: As a user, I want the interface to adapt to my device and browser, so that it is usable wherever I open it.
technical_task: Make the layout responsive so it adapts to different devices and browsers.
acceptance_criteria: Given different screen sizes, when the interface is displayed, then it adapts to each.
Given different supported browsers, when the interface is displayed, then it works in each.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The supported devices and browsers are not listed.

requirement_text: Support Services shall switch to the redundant MPCC device to continue telemetry and/or remote commanding operations. Note that there are only two CTCs. CTC1 is connected to FCC1 and FCC3. CTC2 is connected to FCC2 and FCC4.
requirement_text_raw: Support Services shall [SRS299] switch to the redundant MPCC device to continue telemetry and/or remote commanding operations.  Note that there are only two CTCs.  CTC1 is connected to FCC1 and FCC3.  CTC2 is connected to FCC2 and FCC4.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want Support Services to switch to the redundant MPCC device to continue telemetry and remote commanding, so that operations are not interrupted.
technical_task: Switch to the redundant MPCC device when needed so that telemetry and/or remote commanding operations can continue.
acceptance_criteria: Given the active MPCC device cannot be used, when Support Services reacts, then it switches to the redundant MPCC device.
Given the switch has happened, when operations continue, then telemetry and/or remote commanding keep working.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. The note about CTC1 and CTC2 is background and not a behaviour.

requirement_text: Customers shall be able to rate restaurants and delivery boys.
user_story: As a customer, I want to rate restaurants and delivery boys, so that my feedback is recorded.
technical_task: Add rating functions for restaurants and for delivery boys.
acceptance_criteria: Given a restaurant, when a customer rates it, then the rating is saved.
Given a delivery boy, when a customer rates the delivery boy, then the rating is saved.

requirement_text: Selected articles from the chancellor’s office daily communications distribution, fed to RSS subscribers on the Get Real site. This feature requires X hours per week of web design resource for editing the URLs to the DSS feed.
rationale: The text contains a placeholder ("X hours") and mixes a feature description with a resource note.
clarification_questions: How many hours per week of web design resource are needed ("X")?
Which behaviour is required of the system beyond feeding articles to RSS subscribers?

requirement_text: User shall enter customer and product information for support.
user_story: As a support agent, I want to enter customer and product information, so that I can handle support cases.
technical_task: Provide entry forms for customer and product information used in support.
acceptance_criteria: Given the support form, when the user enters customer information, then it is saved.
Given the support form, when the user enters product information, then it is saved.

requirement_text: System shall ensure privacy while displaying attendee information to trainers.
user_story: As an attendee, I want my information to be displayed to trainers in a way that protects my privacy, so that only necessary details are shared.
technical_task: Display attendee information to trainers with privacy protections applied.
acceptance_criteria: Given a trainer views attendees, when attendee information is displayed, then privacy is ensured.
Given an attendee detail not meant for trainers, when a trainer views the attendee, then that detail is not shown.
rationale: Role assumed: attendee. Which details are private is not stated.

requirement_text: In case of multicast streams the CNG should support proxy functionalities to optimize the management of information related to signalling.
user_story: As a network engineer, I want the CNG to support proxy functionalities for multicast streams, so that signalling information is managed more efficiently.
technical_task: Add proxy functionality to the CNG for multicast streams to optimize handling of signalling-related information.
acceptance_criteria: Given a multicast stream, when it passes through the CNG, then the CNG's proxy functionality is applied.
Given signalling information in a multicast stream, when it is processed, then the proxy functionality is used to manage it.

requirement_text: Upon CPU reset caused by power on, watchdog timer or by other means, Start Up shall execute the initial BIT (IBIT).
requirement_text_raw: Upon CPU reset caused by power on, watchdog timer or by other means, Start Up shall (3.3.2.1) execute the initial BIT (IBIT).
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want Start Up to run the initial BIT after any CPU reset, so that the CPU is tested on every restart.
technical_task: Run the initial BIT in Start Up after every CPU reset, whether caused by power on, the watchdog timer or other means.
acceptance_criteria: Given a CPU reset caused by power on, when Start Up runs, then the initial BIT (IBIT) is executed.
Given a CPU reset caused by the watchdog timer or other means, when Start Up runs, then the initial BIT (IBIT) is executed.

requirement_text: The system shall perform content processing tasks efficiently.
rationale: "Content processing tasks" and "efficiently" are not defined.
clarification_questions: Which content processing tasks are meant?

requirement_text: Applicants shall be automatically logged out after a period of inactivity to ensure security.
user_story: As an applicant, I want to be logged out automatically after a period of inactivity, so that my account stays secure.
technical_task: End the applicant's session automatically after a period of inactivity.
acceptance_criteria: Given a logged-in applicant, when the applicant is inactive for the set period, then the applicant is logged out.
Given a logged-in applicant, when the applicant remains active, then the applicant stays logged in.
rationale: Role stated: applicant. The inactivity period is not given.

requirement_text: The system shall allow the administrator to extract statistics of use, standard delay of reply by member/period, percentage of unsuccessful transaction.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to extract usage statistics, the standard delay of reply by member and period, and the percentage of unsuccessful transactions, so that I can review service quality.
technical_task: Provide extraction of usage statistics, standard reply delay by member and period, and the percentage of unsuccessful transactions.
acceptance_criteria: Given recorded usage, when the administrator extracts statistics, then usage statistics are produced.
Given recorded transactions, when the administrator extracts statistics, then the standard delay of reply by member and period and the percentage of unsuccessful transactions are included.

requirement_text: System provides a listing of privileged account holders within the System hosting environment.
user_story: As a system auditor, I want a listing of privileged account holders within the hosting environment, so that I know who has elevated access.
technical_task: Generate a list of privileged account holders in the System hosting environment.
acceptance_criteria: Given privileged accounts in the hosting environment, when the listing is requested, then all privileged account holders are listed.
Given a new privileged account, when the listing is requested again, then the new holder is included.

requirement_text: Draper shall not violate the 100 microseconds requirement.
requirement_text_raw: Draper shall (3.5.5) not violate the 100 microseconds requirement.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want Draper to meet the 100 microseconds requirement, so that timing is not violated.
technical_task: Keep Draper within the 100 microseconds limit.
acceptance_criteria: Given Draper's operation, when its timing is measured, then it stays within 100 microseconds.
Given a measured time above 100 microseconds, when it is evaluated, then the requirement is violated.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. What operation the 100 microseconds applies to is not stated in the sentence.

requirement_text: Redundancy Management shall implement the following strategies to reconfigure hardware resources: a) degrade the FCP virtual group, b) re-integrate an FCP processor into the FCP virtual group, c) re-integrate a Network Element, or d) mask a Network Element.
requirement_text_raw:
1. Redundancy Management shall [SRS104] implement the following strategies to reconfigure hardware resources:
a) degrade the FCP virtual group,
b) re-integrate an FCP processor into the FCP virtual group,
c) re-integrate a Network Element, or
d) mask a Network Element.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want Redundancy Management to degrade the FCP virtual group, re-integrate an FCP processor, re-integrate a Network Element or mask a Network Element, so that hardware can be reconfigured.
technical_task: Implement four reconfiguration strategies in Redundancy Management: degrade the FCP virtual group, re-integrate an FCP processor into it, re-integrate a Network Element, and mask a Network Element.
acceptance_criteria: Given a hardware fault, when Redundancy Management reconfigures resources, then it can degrade the FCP virtual group.
Given a recovered FCP processor or Network Element, when Redundancy Management reconfigures resources, then it can re-integrate it.
Given a faulty Network Element, when Redundancy Management reconfigures resources, then it can mask the Network Element.

requirement_text: System shall be able to send newsletters regarding promotions.
user_story: As a marketing manager, I want to send newsletters about promotions, so that customers hear about offers.
technical_task: Add newsletter sending for promotion announcements.
acceptance_criteria: Given a promotion, when the manager sends a newsletter, then the newsletter is sent.
Given a sent newsletter, when it is viewed, then it contains the promotion.

requirement_text: The system shall protect private information in accordance with the organization's information policy.
requirement_text_raw: The system shall protect private information in accordance with the organization's information policy.'
user_story: As a privacy officer, I want private information protected in accordance with the organization's information policy, so that we stay compliant.
technical_task: Apply the protections required by the organization's information policy to private information.
acceptance_criteria: Given private information, when it is stored or used, then it is protected as required by the organization's information policy.
Given the information policy, when the protections are reviewed, then they follow it.
rationale: Role assumed: privacy officer. The policy's content is not given.

requirement_text: Under certain circumstances it might be necessary to change a value.
rationale: "Certain circumstances" and "a value" are not specified, and "might" makes the sentence a possibility.
clarification_questions: Which circumstances make a change necessary?
Which value must be changeable, and by whom?

requirement_text: The details of the stator hub and the interface between the stator lamination / stacks shall be designed by the supplier.
user_story: As a project manager, I want the supplier to design the stator hub and the interface between the stator lamination and stacks, so that the supplier owns that design.
technical_task: Assign to the supplier the design of the stator hub details and of the interface between the stator lamination and stacks.
acceptance_criteria: Given the stator hub, when the design is delivered, then it was designed by the supplier.
Given the interface between the stator lamination and stacks, when the design is delivered, then it was designed by the supplier.

requirement_text: Start Up shall make their state congruent.
requirement_text_raw: Start Up shall (3.3.2.13) make their state congruent.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want Start Up to make the states congruent, so that the processors begin from the same state.
technical_task: Have Start Up bring the states of the involved units into congruence.
acceptance_criteria: Given units with different states, when Start Up runs, then their states are made congruent.
Given units with congruent states, when Start Up finishes, then the states remain congruent.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. Which states "their" refers to is not named.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to store Data Packages in GitHub and automatically publish them to CKAN.
user_story: As a data publisher, I want to store Data Packages in GitHub and have them published to CKAN automatically, so that publishing needs no manual steps.
technical_task: Support storing Data Packages in GitHub and publishing them to CKAN without manual action.
acceptance_criteria: Given a Data Package, when the user stores it in GitHub, then it is stored there.
Given a Data Package stored in GitHub, when publishing is triggered, then it is published to CKAN automatically.

requirement_text: The MultiMahjongClient will automate the picking up of a tile from the wall if the user has no other option.
user_story: As a player, I want the game to pick up a tile from the wall for me when I have no other option, so that the game continues.
technical_task: Automate picking a tile from the wall in the MultiMahjongClient when the user has no other option.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user has no other option, when it is the user's turn, then the MultiMahjongClient picks up a tile from the wall.
Given the user has another option, when it is the user's turn, then the tile is not picked automatically.

requirement_text: The software shall be designed for cross-platform compatibility, ensuring it runs on Microsoft Windows, Apple Macintosh, Android phones, iPhones, and personal computers.
user_story: As a user, I want the software to run on Microsoft Windows, Apple Macintosh, Android phones, iPhones and personal computers, so that I can use my own device.
technical_task: Design the software to be cross-platform for Microsoft Windows, Apple Macintosh, Android phones, iPhones and personal computers.
acceptance_criteria: Given a device running Microsoft Windows or Apple Macintosh, when the software is installed, then it runs.
Given an Android phone or an iPhone, when the software is installed, then it runs.

requirement_text: A hashing algorithm with a security strength equal to or greater than SHA-1 (Secure Hash Algorithm (SHA-1) as specified by the NIST in FIPS PUB 180-3 (October 2008)) should be used to verify that electronic health information has not been altered.
requirement_text_raw: A hashing algorithm with a security strength equal to or greater than SHA-1 (Secure Hash Algorithm (SHA-1) as specified by the NIST in FIPS PUB 180-3 (October  2008)) should be used to verify that electronic health information has not been altered.
user_story: As a security officer, I want a hashing algorithm at least as strong as SHA-1 used to verify that electronic health information has not been altered, so that tampering is detected.
technical_task: Verify the integrity of electronic health information with a hashing algorithm whose security strength is equal to or greater than SHA-1.
acceptance_criteria: Given electronic health information, when its integrity is verified, then a hashing algorithm at least as strong as SHA-1 is used.
Given altered electronic health information, when its hash is checked, then the alteration is detected.

requirement_text: User shall receive adherence to SLAs for uptime and performance, including monitoring of database performance and alerts for potential issues.
rationale: The SLAs and targets are not given, and the sentence mixes several behaviours.
clarification_questions: Which SLAs and which uptime and performance targets apply?
What alerts should be sent, and to whom?

requirement_text: The system shall display dates and times in the user's local timezone.
user_story: As a user, I want dates and times shown in my local timezone, so that I don't have to convert them.
technical_task: Convert and display all dates and times in the user's local timezone.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user in a timezone, when a date and time is displayed, then it is shown in that user's local timezone.
Given two users in different timezones, when they view the same event, then each sees it in their own local time.

requirement_text: FDIR shall receive this information and, after two consecutive missed “heartbeats,” conclude that the ICP is failed.
requirement_text_raw: FDIR shall (3.3.5.2) receive this information and, after two consecutive missed “heartbeats,” conclude that the ICP is failed.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want FDIR to conclude that the ICP has failed after two consecutive missed heartbeats, so that failed ICPs are detected.
technical_task: Have FDIR receive heartbeat information and declare the ICP failed after two consecutive missed heartbeats.
acceptance_criteria: Given two consecutive missed heartbeats, when FDIR evaluates the information, then it concludes that the ICP is failed.
Given one missed heartbeat, when FDIR evaluates the information, then it does not conclude that the ICP is failed.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. "This information" is the heartbeat information.

requirement_text: System shall open a new window for users to compose and view messages, retrieving previous messages from the database.
user_story: As a user, I want a new window to compose and view messages with previous messages loaded from the database, so that I can see the conversation.
technical_task: Open a new window for composing and viewing messages that loads earlier messages from the database.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user wants to write or read messages, when the user opens messaging, then a new window opens.
Given the new window is open, when it loads, then previous messages are retrieved from the database and shown.

requirement_text: The solution should implement technical policies and procedures for electronic information solutions that maintain electronic protected health information to allow access only to those persons or software programs that have been granted access rights as specified in 45 CFR 164.308(a)(4) .
user_story: As a compliance officer, I want access limited to persons or software programs that have been granted access rights, so that we meet 45 CFR 164.308(a)(4).
technical_task: Implement technical policies and procedures that allow access to electronic protected health information only to persons or software programs with granted access rights, as specified in 45 CFR 164.308(a)(4).
acceptance_criteria: Given a person or software program with granted access rights, when it requests electronic protected health information, then access is allowed.
Given a person or software program without granted access rights, when it requests electronic protected health information, then access is denied.

requirement_text: A user (a patient) chooses to display his or her appointments in the current month together with his or her office visit dates prescription dates and lab procedure dates of the current month on a calendar for the current month.
requirement_text_raw: A user (a patient) chooses to display his or her appointments in the current month together with his or her office visit dates  prescription dates  and lab procedure dates of the current month on a calendar for the current month.
user_story: As a patient, I want a calendar for the current month showing my appointments and my office visit, prescription and lab procedure dates, so that I can see my health schedule.
technical_task: Display a calendar of the current month showing the patient's appointments together with office visit, prescription and lab procedure dates.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient with appointments in the current month, when the patient opens the calendar, then the appointments are displayed.
Given office visit, prescription and lab procedure dates in the current month, when the patient opens the calendar, then those dates are displayed too.

requirement_text: The pressure compensation membrane is held closed by fingers and the test sample is submerged in water.
rationale: The sentence describes a test setup and gives no pass or fail criterion.
clarification_questions: Is this a test procedure or a requirement on the product?
What outcome must the pressure compensation membrane achieve under test?

requirement_text: System shall adopt a flexible service-based architecture to support future expansion and scalability.
user_story: As a system architect, I want a flexible service-based architecture, so that the system can expand and scale in the future.
technical_task: Adopt a service-based architecture so that new services can be added and capacity scaled.
acceptance_criteria: Given the architecture description, when it is reviewed, then the system is built from services.
Given a new service is needed, when it is added, then existing services need little or no change.
rationale: Role assumed: system architect. "Flexible" is not measured.

requirement_text: The solution should provide audit capabilities to capture solution events at the hardware and software architecture level.
user_story: As a security administrator, I want audit capabilities that capture events at the hardware and software architecture level, so that I can trace what happened.
technical_task: Capture solution events at both the hardware and the software architecture level in the audit function.
acceptance_criteria: Given an event at the hardware level, when it occurs, then it is captured by the audit capabilities.
Given an event at the software architecture level, when it occurs, then it is captured by the audit capabilities.
